# P02 frozen design fixtures

These files pin the `island/mujoco-sim@0.1.1` scene/device catalog. `target-descriptor.json` is the additive `backend-v2.json` schema-`2.0.0` output with exact `catalog_version:"0.1.0"`; its scene hashes match the two repository XML files. `legacy-descriptor.json` has neither discriminator nor any target metadata. Any partial mix fails. `expected-contribution.json` records the new process type and seven type IDs in the `0.1.0` `sim-hardware` template. `negative-cases.json` records JSON Pointer mutations and machine-checkable `{code,path,stage}` results for direct package verification and graph semantic admission, plus the revision boundary. `tests/scene_catalog.py` exercises the direct package cases. A descriptor mutation applied after a sealed P01 receipt first yields `package_changed` rather than its P02 semantic code; the IsOS companion tests exercise graph admission and revision behavior.

P01 verifies the exact receipt, payload tree, sidecar and safe paths first. P02 may derive options only from that verified handle. P03 defines the generic node-options response. R05 later validates device IDs and commands on the private socket. No fixture grants actuator authority or changes legacy graph bytes.
